notes.title: EXTRACT ME to be retired.
notes.notes: [p]Due to issues not resolvable in UE4, a few errors in this game broke the experience. The title would need to be remade in UE5 from the ground up to avoid the problems that were not fixable in UE4 - which this game was built on. If you have purchased this title, you should still own the game, but further purchases will not be made available.[/p]
